_comment: SHA-256 of each go.dev/dl/goVERSION.linux-amd64.tar.gz, pinned per version.
Measured with sha256sum on the downloaded archive on 2026-10-07; each equals the
sha256 go.dev publishes in https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all. The digest
is what makes the build fail instead of installing something else.
To add or bump a version: download the archive, run sha256sum, and record it here
beside the version in versions.json. stacks/golang/digests.test.sh holds the two
